findings.title: Untested-compatibility caveat for a disclosed species undercuts enablement of the broader claimed material genus
findings.attack: Claims 27 and 70 claim "a superelastic material" as a genus; [0206] discloses copper-based superelastic alloys as a species and states their sealant compatibility "is not established", which an examiner can use against enablement/written description for the full claimed breadth.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence clarifying the claimed mechanical function does not depend on sealant compatibility, which is a separate material-selection question.

findings.title: "FIGS. 13B is" grammatical number mismatch
findings.attack: Plural "FIGS." governs a single figure reference and singular verb.

findings.title: Locked terminology table has no row for several terms used in the claims and description
findings.attack: "Slotted sleeve", "split seat ring", "tapered seat ring" and "matching taper" are used in claims 39-44 and description [0176]-[0178] without a corresponding LOCKED.md row; the deterministic terms check's only warning on this area (an undeclared-synonym hit on "split seat" against the "two-piece seat" row) is a false positive on inspection, since "split seat ring" (180) and "two-piece seat" (140/144) are structurally distinct and separately numbered, which masks the real gap that these terms were never locked at all.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add rows to terminology/LOCKED.md for the missing terms per the table's own Note 1.

findings.title: Registry document carries a stale drafting-process note inconsistent with the package's current state
findings.attack: registry.md states description.md and claims.md "do not yet exist in this run" and that the numeral cross-check "must be re-run... once both exist"; both files exist in this package and the cross-check has in fact been run cleanly against them, so the note is stale and should not appear in text given to a blind reviewer.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Remove or update the stale flag once the cross-check has been run against the current description and claims.

findings.title: Brief description of the drawings omits FIG. 13A, registered in the numeral registry as numeral 220
findings.attack: 37 CFR 1.74/MPEP 608.01(f) require every figure to be described; FIG. 13A and numeral 220 are registered but never described in the Brief Description or Detailed Description.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add Brief Description and Detailed Description text for FIG. 13A/220, or remove FIG. 13A and numeral 220 from the figure plan and registry.

findings.title: Description grammatical mismatch at [0049]
findings.attack: "FIGS. 13B is" pairs a plural article with a single figure reference and singular verb.

findings.title: EPO two-part claim form not used
findings.attack: Claims 1 and 3 are single-part form throughout; Rule 43(1) EPC contemplates a preamble/characterising-portion split, though single-part form is commonly accepted at filing.
findings.least_narrowing_action: No correction needed at filing; prepare a two-part fallback of claim 1 against US4044791A/US3473561A for use if the EPO examiner requests it.

findings.title: Non-standard dependent-claim format
findings.attack: Claims 47, 61, 77 and 86 embed multi-claim cross-references inside the claim body/preamble rather than a standard dependency clause, obscuring dependency and category and compounding F-40a-1 for claim 61 especially.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Rewrite with the full base range in the introductory dependency clause; see Prompt 37 reply F-37-4.

findings.title: No drawing sheets exist; only figure instructions
findings.attack: The description relies on FIGS. 1-13B but only a figure plan and instructions exist. Late-filed drawings risk missing-parts treatment (Rule 56 EPC; s.15(5) PA 1977) and new matter in the US; drawing formalities (Rule 46 EPC; 37 CFR 1.84; r.14 PR 2007) cannot be checked.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Render drawing sheets from the figure instructions, check every numeral against registry.md, file them with the description, and remove the candidate/unconfirmed wording from the captions once the inventor has decided on those constructions.

findings.title: The package has no abstract
findings.attack: An abstract is required in all three offices (37 CFR 1.72(b); Art. 78(1)(e) and Rule 47 EPC; s.14(2)(d) PA 1977). None is in the package, so question 12 cannot be answered and an abstract drafted later would be unreviewed text.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Draft an abstract of not more than 150 words summarising claims 1, 2 and 3 in the locked terms, with reference signs and no 'means for' language, and check it against question 12 before Gate 3.
